# Gadfly — User Stories
> ✅ done (shipped & tested) · 🟡 partial · ⬜ planned. Every ✅ cites the test.

## Priority backlog
_Nothing recorded yet._


## Epic SA — Socratic platform: foundation
- **GAD-US-SA1 ⬜** As MindAttic, Gadfly is a reusable Socratic engine any app can embed, with today's personal introspection tool as one consumer of it.


## Epic SB — Socratic platform: the engine
- **GAD-US-SB1 ⬜** As an examiner, I can run an adaptive Socratic exam that probes a student's understanding of each concept, confronts contradictions in their own claims, and stops at mastery, aporia or the time budget.
- **GAD-US-SB2 ⬜** As an instructor, I get a per-concept report with quoted evidence, source citations and the judges' dissent, as a recommendation I finalize.


## Epic SC — Socratic platform: source material and grounding
- **GAD-US-SC1 ⬜** As an instructor, I upload my own source material and get an editable concept map and rubric that every question and judgment is grounded in, with citations.


## Epic SD — Socratic platform: hosted server and API
- **GAD-US-SD1 ⬜** As the platform, every live session runs server-side with its turns, judgments and events persisted in SQL Server, resumable after a disconnect.
- **GAD-US-SD2 ⬜** As a third-party app, I can create exams, launch sessions in an embedded room and receive results through a keyed API and webhooks.


## Epic SF — Socratic platform: customer and student accounts
- **GAD-US-SF1 ⬜** As a customer org admin, I invite instructors and students into my organization, each with a role, and nobody ever sees another organization's data.


## Epic SG — Socratic platform: exam web app
- **GAD-US-SG1 ⬜** As a student, I check my mic and camera, consent, and take a spoken exam with a talking examiner that listens and follows up on what I said.
- **GAD-US-SG2 ⬜** As an instructor, I build exams from my sources, assign them, review each session's transcript, scores and evidence, and finalize the grade.


## Epic SI — Socratic platform: integrity
- **GAD-US-SI1 ⬜** As an instructor, I see integrity evidence (faces, voices, off-screen reading, focus loss, answer cadence) explained on the session timeline, with no automated accusation and no deception or emotion inference.


## Epic SP — Socratic platform: production and pilot
- **GAD-US-SP1 ⬜** As MindAttic, the platform runs on Azure with consent, retention, security and cost controls, and has been piloted with Erin's real exams.


## Epic MP — Master plan MVP: Socratic assessment with human-AI grading
- **GAD-US-MP1 ⬜** As an institution, I run adaptive Socratic examinations whose every response is verified and preserved, scored by AI per learning objective and independently by a human, reconciled when they disagree, combined by an approved weighting policy, and released only after authorized approval (docs/MASTER-PLAN.md).

| GAD-T73 | 2026-11-20 | fix | closed | HttpTenantContext reports IsSystem=true whenever IHttpContextAccessor.HttpContext is null, which turns off the tenant query filter and the write guard. Inside an interactive Blazor Server circuit HttpContext is not guaranteed (null on long-polling/SSE transports, timers, background continuations), so component queries could run unfiltered. Pin the tenant at circuit start from the AuthenticationStateProvider, fall back to 'no tenant' (sees nothing) instead of system, and make system an explicit opt-in for background scopes (GAD-T64 security review). | 77e3c46 |
| GAD-T74 | 2026-11-20 | fix | closed | SessionOrchestrator's live-session cache only compared the organization, so any student in the same organization who knew a session id could read its question, answer into it or end it via the hub/exam room before the ownership check in PersistAsync ran (the in-memory engine was already changed). Check the student on the cached path and before broadcasting Thinking (GAD-T64 security review). | 5c3df94 |
| GAD-T75 | 2026-11-20 | fix | closed | Webhook URLs only had to be https, so an org admin or API key could point deliveries at localhost, private ranges, link-local/metadata addresses or internal hostnames (blind SSRF with the response code shown as an oracle; redirects followed). Refuse non-public targets at registration and at connect time (DNS-rebinding safe) and stop following redirects (GAD-T64 security review). | dbc4c17 |
| GAD-T76 | 2026-11-20 | fix | closed | Organization memberships ride on the sign-in cookie, so removing a member or changing their role only took effect at their next sign-in, and an Admin could demote or deactivate an Owner (and so leave the organization ownerless). Rotate the account's security stamp on role/active changes so live sessions and circuits revalidate within a minute, and only an Owner may change an Owner or grant Owner (GAD-T64 security review). | e401ab1 |
